thread:
Maya: Morning team — kicking off onboarding for Equinox (EU pilot). High-level success criteria: 1) EU-only data residency for all inference and logs, 2) <30ms p95 tail for typical chat workload, 3) SSO + audit logs in place by go-live (60 days). Need to confirm stakeholders, immediate blockers, and proposed timeline below. @Aria pls confirm SSO provider + any PII concerns. Proposed timeline: week0: security & DPA; week1: network + sandbox; week2: test harness + perf; week3: pilot + enablement. Checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/templates/eu-poc-checklist

Aria: Thanks Maya — Equinox confirms Okta SSO, strict EU-only data residency (want FR region), and we store limited PII (user display name, email). Procurement needs DPA signed before we move prod. Can you provision a sandbox that purges data nightly?

Luca: Infrastructure here — we can run the private control plane in eu-west-1 and tie KMS to a customer-managed key. Sandbox with nightly purge is doable. I'll need VPC peering details and whether they want public egress blocked.

Priya: Legal — we'll need the DPA + vendor security questionnaire filled. Send ISO27001 and SOC2 docs. I estimate ~7 business days for review unless there are outstanding items.

Jensen: Eng question: for the perf target, what's the expected request pattern? typical tokens, batch sizes, and concurrency target? that'll affect kernel/layout choices.

Maya: Equinox expects chat-like traffic: multi-turn (3 turns avg), ~150 tokens per response, peak concurrency ~60 rps. We should plan a synthetic load with those params.

Sam: Ops scheduling — propose an ops sync Wed 09:30 UTC to align network, legal, and eng. I can send invites and a short runbook. Who's available?

Aria: Wed 09:30 works for our engineers. Sandbox API key that auto-resets would be ideal — don't want any real customer data in tests.

onboard-bot: Sandbox key request created: #CS-4123 — assigned to Luca. ETA depends on VPC setup.

Luca: Confirmed — I'll provision the sandbox in eu-west-1 with KMS, nightly purge job, and limited egress. Expect initial provision ~48 hours after VPC peering is complete.

Priya: Also flagging a renewal risk we noticed: Equinox's procurement timeline may push signatures late; contract auto-renews 30 days after pilot unless procurement halts it. Add a renewal checkpoint at day 45 to avoid surprises.

Maya: Good catch. Action items summary: Maya -> send DPA draft to Aria; Priya -> review DPA and security docs; Luca -> VPC peering, KMS, sandbox provisioning; Jensen -> build test harness + perf scripts (150 toks, 3-turn chat); Sam -> schedule Wed sync, publish runbook and add load-run in week 2. I'll update the success-criteria doc and share after this thread.

Aria: Who should our infra team share peering info with? Also need SAML metadata for Okta.

Luca: I'm the infra contact (luca@redwood.com). Please send peering CIDR + SAML metadata to solutions@redwood.com and I'll pick it up.

Jensen: Small perf note — we'll enable prefix KV caching and continuous batching in the harness. Recommend a 1-hour 60-rps soak test in week 2 to validate p95 latency.

Sam: Added the 1-hour soak test to the runbook and a renewal-risk row on the onboarding board.

Aria: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick alignment. See you on Wed.
